installCommand: npm config set allow-scripts true && npm install --include=optional && python -m venv .venv-vercel && . .venv-vercel/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && deactivate
buildCommand: . .venv-vercel/bin/activate && cd backend && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && cd .. && npm run build && deactivate
